alerts.headline: Air Quality Alert issued October 8 at 11:08PM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
alerts.area: Bandera; Kendall; Medina; Bexar; Comal; Guadalupe; Atascosa; Wilson
alerts.description:
AQAEWX

The Texas Commission on Environmental Quality (TCEQ) has issued
an Ozone Action Day for the San Antonio area for Friday, October
9, 2026.

Atmospheric conditions are expected to be favorable for producing
high levels of ozone air pollution in the San Antonio area on
Saturday.

You can help prevent ozone pollution by sharing a ride, walking
or riding a bicycle, taking your lunch to work, avoiding drive
through lanes, conserving energy, and keeping your vehicle
properly tuned.

If required, the next Ozone Action Day will be issued by 3 PM on
Friday, October 9, 2026.
